name: esphome
protocols: ESPHome native API over TCP, plaintext or Noise encrypted
families: ESP32, ESP8266, RP2040 and BK72xx boards running ESPHome
sensors, switches, lights, fans, numbers, selects and buttons defined in ESPHome YAML
tests: native API simulator over a local TCP socket, driven by the real aioesphomeapi client

estimate.devices: every ESPHome node, hundreds of thousands of installs
estimate.reasoning: ESPHome is the most common firmware for DIY ESP-based devices and is preinstalled on a growing set of commercial products under the Made for ESPHome program. Every node uses the same native API, and the driver maps the common entity types without per-device code.
